name: Gradle
description: Gradle projects: offered when a project has settings.gradle(.kts) or build.gradle(.kts); the Gradle tool window (the build's projects and tasks, run a task, Reload All Gradle Projects), run configurations of kind Gradle with the project's gradlew first, and Groovy build scripts (*.gradle) highlighted, folded and outlined. Kotlin build scripts (*.gradle.kts) are read by the Kotlin plug-in.
